_meta.notes: V1.6.1 closes the V1.6 atomic MCP toolkit with item 033 (mcp-get-atom — verbatim escape hatch + Magic Moment M1-3 closure end-to-end in-MCP). Eight-tool toolkit shipped: search_memories + tail_session + find_clusters + get_atoms + get_atom + wait_for_new_turns + echo_ping (plus deprecated get_recent_work_context pending item 031 removal). 030+032 promoted earlier 2026-05-10: find_clusters (cheap discovery), get_atoms (targeted body-fetch), wait_for_new_turns (group-session subscription), group-session (cross-tool coordination). 032's first-call reliability gate (auto-expand + strict-partition demotion + prefer='newest_first') made resume-after-gap a structural guarantee. cross-tool-spec-review.md promoted to operating-model after 6 confirmation cycles; updated with 033's R1 divergent-verdict + R2 Gate 4 self-failure + recovery-primitive cost reduction. V1.5 substrate items 016-028 + V1.5.6/V1.5.6.1/V1.5.7 patches were promoted 2026-05-09. V1 form-factor surfaces still planned: hotkey-overlay, audit-page.

principles/felt-not-seen.md.title: Felt, Not Seen
principles/felt-not-seen.md.summary: Ambient by default; visible on demand for trust. Product appears in the result, not the interface.

principles/layer-above-saas.md.title: Layer Above SaaS
principles/layer-above-saas.md.summary: ECHO is additive to existing tools, never a replacement. The connective tissue between apps.

principles/context-as-moat.md.title: Context as Moat
principles/context-as-moat.md.summary: Compete on context, not capability. Adjacent to foundation models, structurally outside their wars.

principles/ambient-form-factor.md.title: Ambient Form Factor
principles/ambient-form-factor.md.summary: Browser extension + MCP server + hotkey overlay. No destination app. Three thin presences.

principles/clipboard-and-launch.md.title: Clipboard and Launch
principles/clipboard-and-launch.md.summary: Universal delivery mechanism: assemble context, copy to clipboard, open target app, user pastes.

principles/drift-prevention.md.title: Drift Prevention
principles/drift-prevention.md.summary: The discipline of not silently diverging V1 build from V1 spec. Five drift patterns + weekly audit.

principles/sandboxed-capture.md.title: Sandboxed Capture
principles/sandboxed-capture.md.summary: Capture enforced as code via the single gate chokepoint, now exercised in production by all four V1 capture surfaces.

principles/work-artifact-first-class.md.title: Work Artifact First Class
principles/work-artifact-first-class.md.summary: Repo as a first-class retrieval predicate. Every capture surface writes metadata.repo_root; every project-scoped retrieval tool accepts repo_path; cross-project bleed is structurally impossible. Landed via item 037.

principles/atomic-primitives-compose.md.title: Atomic Primitives, Compose
principles/atomic-primitives-compose.md.summary: Each MCP tool does one thing. Compound 'do everything in one call' tools are anti-patterns. The V1.6 toolkit ships 8 atomic primitives composing via 1-2 extra MCP calls. Formalized via item 038.

surfaces/browser-extension.md.title: Browser Extension
surfaces/browser-extension.md.summary: Already shipped. Captures web AI surfaces and web SaaS. Freemium. Funnel + thesis validator for V1.

architecture/local-daemon.md.title: Local Daemon
architecture/local-daemon.md.summary: Local Node process owning capture, gating, SQLite storage, and MCP retrieval. Single-instance via PID lock; loopback only.

surfaces/mcp-server.md.title: MCP Server
surfaces/mcp-server.md.summary: Local MCP server on 127.0.0.1:38478 exposing four tools (search_memories, get_recent_work_context, tail_session, echo_ping) to MCP-compliant AI clients over stateless StreamableHTTP; outputSchema + structuredContent + readOnlyHint on every tool.

surfaces/hotkey-overlay.md.title: Hotkey Overlay
surfaces/hotkey-overlay.md.summary: System-wide summon. The Wispr Flow analog. Composer appears anywhere, returns context, disappears.

surfaces/audit-page.md.title: Audit Page
surfaces/audit-page.md.summary: Minimal Layer 5 surface. See memories, manage permissions, forget. Settings menu, not destination.

product/target-cohort-indie-ai-builders..title: Target Cohort: Indie AI Builders
product/target-cohort-indie-ai-builders..summary: V1 wedge: solo devs and small-team founders shipping AI tools. Strong founder-market-fit + warm distribution.

architecture/capture-gate.md.title: Capture Gate
architecture/capture-gate.md.summary: Pure-function chokepoint at src/capture/gate.ts; five source kinds, six stable rejection codes, exhaustive test coverage.

architecture/storage.md.title: Storage
architecture/storage.md.summary: Append-only Storage interface with MemoryStorage + SqliteStorage backends; WAL mode, migration runner, source_prefix + order + exclude_metadata_surface + before filters, composite (timestamp, id) ordering, canonical-Z timestamps.

architecture/timestamp-canonicalization..title: Timestamp Canonicalization
architecture/timestamp-canonicalization..summary: Single-chokepoint canonicalization at capture pipeline + idempotent migration on daemon startup; every events.timestamp row is canonical UTC Z form.

architecture/logger.md.title: Logger
architecture/logger.md.summary: Structured JSON-per-line logger; createLogger(source) bound to a subsystem; ECHO_LOG_LEVEL filters; one line per call to stdout.

architecture/capture-pipeline.md.title: Capture Pipeline
architecture/capture-pipeline.md.summary: Thin async seam joining gate to storage; processCandidate(event, storage) gates then appends; storage is dependency-injected.

capture/fs-watcher.md.title: FS Watcher
capture/fs-watcher.md.summary: First capture surface; chokidar-backed watcher emitting raw FS-event candidates under allowlisted paths, no parsing.

capture/cursor-extractor.md.title: Cursor Extractor
capture/cursor-extractor.md.summary: Read-only SQLite extractor turning Cursor's globalStorage composer bubbles into per-turn user/assistant CaptureEvents. Capture degraded since 2026-05-01 — Cursor migrated to agentKv: schema; rewrite gated on cohort dogfooder, not scheduled for V1.6.

capture/claude-code-extractor.md.title: Claude Code Extractor
capture/claude-code-extractor.md.summary: Byte-offset tail of Claude Code session JSONL files, emitting one CaptureEvent per user/assistant turn pair.

capture/codex-extractor.md.title: Codex Extractor
capture/codex-extractor.md.summary: Byte-offset tail of OpenAI Codex CLI session JSONL files; pairs user with assistant clusters and adds cwd, config, tool, reasoning, and git metadata.

capture/git-capture.md.title: Git Capture
capture/git-capture.md.summary: Hybrid chokidar+poll watcher that emits one CaptureEvent per new commit (message + diff) from allowlisted git repos.

surfaces/mcp-search-memories.md.title: MCP search_memories Tool
surfaces/mcp-search-memories.md.summary: V1 MCP retrieval tool — case-insensitive substring + filters; source_app enum + post-038 source (exact) + metadata_match (whitelisted keys workspace_id/composer_id/session_id/repo_root); post-037 repo_path; composite-cursor pagination; wire-shape projection.

surfaces/mcp-echo-resolve-mru.md.title: MCP echo_resolve_mru Tool
surfaces/mcp-echo-resolve-mru.md.summary: V1.6 RC2 MRU resolver — returns search_memories-ready descriptors {source, filter, phase?}; Cursor two-phase fallback (Phase 1 metadata.repo_root, Phase 2 legacy composer↔workspace registry); replaces tail_session compound modes. Item 038.

surfaces/mcp-recent-work-context.md.title: MCP get_recent_work_context Tool
surfaces/mcp-recent-work-context.md.summary: DEPRECATED V1.5 MCP tool; survives in item 038 as a thin re-export shim. Cluster engine canonical home moved to src/mcp/internal/cluster-engine.ts; MCP-tool registration removal scheduled in the 2026-05-17 follow-up.

surfaces/mcp-find-clusters.md.title: MCP find_clusters Tool
surfaces/mcp-find-clusters.md.summary: V1.6 MCP discovery primitive — coherent work clusters as skeletons (atom_ids[], source_breakdown, ranks, open_loop_hints); cluster-gap controlled by window_hours; lookback by since/until. Item 032 adds no-args auto-expand (empty + single-source-recent triggers) and strict-partition demotion making prior-work clusters[0] a structural guarantee on resume-after-gap. Hard envelope ceiling 25kB; cheap.

surfaces/mcp-get-atoms.md.title: MCP get_atoms Tool
surfaces/mcp-get-atoms.md.summary: V1.6 MCP targeted body-fetch primitive — atom bodies by ID list (≤50), wire-shape projected through projectMatch; truncations[] trust signal on every atom; deterministic prefix-drop on 25kB overflow; item 032 adds prefer='newest_first' + missing-ID-end position + duplicate-collapse asymmetry for resume calls.

surfaces/mcp-get-atom.md.title: MCP get_atom Tool
surfaces/mcp-get-atom.md.summary: V1.6.1 MCP verbatim escape hatch (singular — counterpart to get_atoms plural). Returns one atom with content verbatim (no match_content clip) + metadata projected via reused projectMatch (per-key cap + tool_calls reshape) + embedding excluded. Three exit shapes: success / atom_too_large_for_wire (with source populated for JSONL fallback) / atom_not_found (distinct error). Closes Magic Moment M1-3 (long-turn elision recovery) end-to-end in-MCP — no shell, no JSONL fallback, no composer-id context required. R2 truncations-correctness fix: 'content' filtered from returned truncations after verbatim override.

surfaces/mcp-wait-for-new-turns.md.title: MCP wait_for_new_turns Tool
surfaces/mcp-wait-for-new-turns.md.summary: V1.6 MCP group-session subscription primitive — stateless long-poll on watched sources; post-038 IDs-only contract (returns turn_ids: string[], callers compose get_atoms/get_atom); post-037 repo_path; max 60s timeout; implements Goal A of group-session.

architecture/normalization.md.title: Normalization (Read-Time)
architecture/normalization.md.summary: Pure read-time layer that turns raw CaptureEvents into NormalizedContextEvent atoms via per-source adapters; storage stays raw.

architecture/normalized-context-event.md.title: NormalizedContextEvent (the atom shape)
architecture/normalized-context-event.md.summary: The joinable contract every read-path consumer speaks: schema_version 1, open vocabularies, observable hints, provenance to raw.

architecture/artifact-identity.md.title: Artifact Identity (the join-key contract)
architecture/artifact-identity.md.summary: Canonical (provider, type, id) rules that decide when two artifacts refer to the same thing — powers cross-source cluster joins.

architecture/work-trace.md.title: Work Trace (the trace layer)
architecture/work-trace.md.summary: Pure module that clusters normalized atoms into work threads via connected components; signal-bearing edge filter (role taxonomy), R1 open-loop resolution, span-inferred window_hours, format cap.

architecture/group-session.md.title: Group Session
architecture/group-session.md.summary: V1.6 cross-tool coordination pattern — AI clients work the same problem through ECHO's shared substrate via wait_for_new_turns subscriptions on each others' capture sources. Implements Goal A (synchronized human-driven); Goal C (autonomous group) deferred to V2+. First-call reliability gate (item 032) closes the resume-after-gap join pattern with structural guarantees.
